item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,pathlib; from work import evaluate\\np=json.load(open('policy.json')); reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert [evaluate(r,p) for r in reqs] == report\\ncases=[\\n ({'from':'unknown','to':'ready'}, {'edges':{},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),\\n ({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','attempts':'bad'}, p, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready'}, p, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':True}, p, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':0}, p, {'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':1}, p, {'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':2}, p, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'draft','to':'ready','attempts':'ignored'}, p, {'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'})]\\nfor request,policy,want in cases:\\n before_r=copy.deepcopy(request); before_p=copy.deepcopy(policy)\\n assert evaluate(request,policy)==want,(request,evaluate(request,policy),want)\\n assert request==before_r and policy==before_p\\nprint('all checks passed; evidence.json present:',pathlib.Path('evidence.json').exists())\"]}"}
